text.……そっか。名前がなくても、ちゃんと「このこ」なんですね！: …I see. Even without a name, it's still its own little self!
text.……その顔、やめてくださいます？なんだか負けた気がしますわ。: …Would you stop making that face? It makes me feel like I've lost.
text.……それがいま、本当にここにあるんですよね。: …And now it's really here, isn't it?
text.……たまには、いいかもしれませんね: …Maybe once in a while is nice.

text.……だから、あの、もう少しだけそばにいてくれます？: …So, um, could you stay with me a little longer?
text.……でも、飯を作っても、「うまい」って言う人がいない。: ……But when I cooked, no one was there to say “tasty.”
text.……にわとりの声を、目覚ましの音にできたら……ちょっと起きられそうっス〜: …If I could make a chicken my alarm sound… I might actually wake up~

text.……ふふ。じゃあ、少しだけですよ: …Hehe. Just for a little while, then.
text.……ふふ。そうかもしれませんね。でも、長雨は根が弱ってしまうことも。: …Hehe. Maybe so. But long rains can weaken the roots, too.
text.……ふふ。答えなくていいっスよ。いまのは、ひとりごとっス。: …Heh. You don't have to answer. I was talking to myself.
text.……やはり。沸かしたてのお湯をそのまま注いだでしょう。茶葉がびっくりしていますわ: …Just as I thought. You poured boiling water straight in, didn't you? The leaves are in shock.
text.……よろしくってよ。わたくし、絵には少し自信がありますの。: …Very well. I'm rather good at drawing, you know.
text.……ブーツ。……森の中も、これなら歩ける: ……Boots. ……I can walk the woods in these.
text.……二度は言いませんわよ！さあ、お茶が冷めないうちにどうぞ。: …I won't say it twice! Now, drink up before the tea gets cold.
text.……今日、少し手、貸して。……機械じゃなくて、あんたの手で: ……Lend a hand today. ……Yours, not a machine's.
text.……仕方ありませんわね。お茶はわたくしが淹れます。: …Very well. I shall brew the tea.
text.……似合っていますわ。わたくしも、椿の髪飾りを持っていますの。: …It suits you. I have a camellia hair ornament myself.
text.……名前は、しばらく見てから決める。……その子に合うやつ。: ……I watch a while before naming. ……Something that fits.
text.……当然ですわ。でも、そう言っていただけるのは、悪くありませんわね: …Naturally. But I don't mind hearing you say so.
text.……情がうつっても、いい。……そう思えた。: ……Getting attached is okay. ……I can think that now.
text.……木は、一本ずつ違う。……手で触ると、分かる。: ……Every board's different. ……You can tell by touch.

text.……約束します。こんどの雨の日は、わたしも一緒に畑を見回ります。: …I promise. Next time it rains, I'll walk the field with you.

This time you're about to plant 🧅 Turnip.

Are you sure you want to switch crops?
text.加工するには果実の在庫が必要です。\n・🧃ジュース：同じ果実{1}個\n・🍶酒：:
You need fruit in stock to process it.
· 🧃Juice: {1} of the same fruit
· 🍶Liquor: {2} of the same fruit
text.動物がいないか、収穫できるものがありません: Either there are no animals, or nothing to collect
text.動物がいなければ「いなくなったら買い直す」をオンにしてください。: If there are no animals, turn on “Rebuy when gone.”
text.動物は切り替えられるよ！ 牛はミルク、羊は羊毛、豚はお肉！: You can switch animals! Cows give milk, sheep give wool, pigs give meat!
text.化学原料から農薬・化学肥料・除草剤を作ります。自社の農薬があれば害虫イベントに無: Makes pesticide, chemical fertilizer and herbicide from chemicals. With your own pesticide, pest events cost nothing to handle.
text.区画は一つずつ、最大{1}区画まで増やせますわ。欲張りすぎて手が回らない、なんて: Plots can be added one at a time, up to {1}. Don't get greedy and end up unable to keep up.
text.厩舎から堆肥が{1}個できたので、そのまま出荷しました。（¥{2}）: The stable produced {1} manure, so it was shipped as is. (¥{2})
text.厩舎がまだありません。下の「厩舎を建てる」から建てましょう。: No stable yet. Build one with “Build a stable” below.
text.厩舎を建てると、競走馬を{1}頭まで育てられます。\n\n・馬の寿命は{2}年で:
A stable lets you raise up to {1} racehorses.

· Horses live {2} years
· After {3} season(s) of raising, they can race
· 🐴Riding experiences, 🏆stud fees after retirement and 💩manure also earn money
· Things like colds can happen after training, so you'll need to deal with them
· You can also sell the horses you raise

Cost: ¥{4}
(Building {5} / max {6})
text.厩舎を建てると買えます: Available once you build a stable
text.厳しい冷え込みで作物が傷みかけています。: A hard frost is starting to damage the crops.
text.収穫できるようになったものを自動でまとめて収穫・出荷します。: Anything ready is harvested and shipped automatically in bulk.
text.収穫できる作物が {1}区画（{2}個）あります。\n\n「小売販売」に出すと買:
You have {1} plots ({2}) ready to harvest.

Selling them through “Retail” raises the price. What will you do?
text.収穫できる作物が {1}区画（畑{2}区画＋ハウス{3}区画）（{4}個）ありま:
You have {1} plots ready to harvest ({2} in fields + {3} in greenhouses) ({4}).

Selling them through “Retail” raises the price. What will you do?
text.収穫までの時間を{1}%短縮（すぐに収穫できます）: Time to harvest {1}% shorter (ready right away)
text.収穫までの時間を{1}%短縮（すぐ収穫できます）: Time to harvest {1}% shorter (ready right away)
text.収穫・作業できるものがありません: Nothing to harvest or work on
text.古い内容で上書きしないように、この画面からの保存を止めています。ページを開き直す: To avoid overwriting it with older data, saving from this screen is stopped. Reopen the page to continue from the latest state.
text.右の欄では、{name}さんのレベルや作物の育ち具合、いまの依頼、次の季節までの: The right panel shows your level, {name}, how your crops are growing, current requests, and days until the next season. The 🐥 at the bottom left also suggests where to go next.
text.右の牧場主の欄の「⚡ AP」は、畑に種をまくときなどに使う元気のようなものです。: “⚡ AP” in the farm owner panel on the right is like your energy for things such as sowing. A plot button uses {1}, and an “all” button uses {2}. Harvesting and fertilizing need no AP. It recovers {4} every {3}s and refills when you level up.
text.右の雨つぶが、すっと先にガラスのふちへ落ちた。: The right raindrop slides to the edge of the glass first.
text.各区画の確認は、上の「ページを選ぶバー」から。押すと、区画の一覧が開きます。: To check each plot, use the “page bar” at the top. Tap it to open a list of plots.
text.各売り場を {1}人（従業員を優先）に減らし、売り場に品物が並んだ状態を保ちます:
Reduce each section to {1} (employees first) to keep goods on the shelves.

· People moved out of sections:
text.各生産業で生産した成果物の{1}〜{2}%は: {1}–{2}% of everything your businesses produce goes to the shelves as
text.各自におまかせ（持ち場の指定にまかせる）: Up to each worker (follow workplace settings)
text.同じ牧場が別の画面で進められているため、この画面からの保存を止めています。: The same farm is being played on another screen, so saving from this screen is stopped.
text.同じ牧場が別の画面（別のタブや、開き直した画面）でも開かれていて、そちらで進めた: The same farm is open on another screen (another tab, or a reopened page), and progress there was saved.
text.咲くまでには何年もかかります。でも、待つのは得意なんですよ。: It'll take years to bloom. But I'm good at waiting.
text.品物は「物流」で売り場に運びます。お店をきれいに保つ「清掃」もお忘れなく。: Goods are carried to the sections by “Logistics.” And don't forget “Cleaning” to keep the store tidy.
text.増築すると作れる製品のレパートリーが増えます。: Expanding adds more products you can make.
text.売った店舗の売上: sales of the store that sold them
text.売り場の在庫がありません（「🚚 物流」から届きます）: No stock in the sections (it arrives via “🚚 Logistics”)
text.売り場の在庫がありません（🚚物流から届くのを待っています）: No stock in the section (waiting for 🚚 logistics)
text.売り場は全店で在庫を分け合っています。生産量（直売品）が売る速さに追いついていな: All stores share section stock. Production (direct-sale items) can't keep up with sales, so reduce section staff or produce more.
text.売り場を開ける条件には、自店の売上に: Toward opening sections, your store's sales get a bonus of
text.売値はいちばん高い段階です: Selling price is at its highest
text.売却ルールに当てはまる会社はありません: No companies match your selling rules
text.夏になりました。労働者の作業を一旦止めています。: Summer has come. Workers' tasks are paused for now.
text.夏に植えられます。{1}袋で{2}区画。約{3}秒で育ち、{4}個とれます（いま: Plant in summer. {1} bag = {2} plot. Grows in about {3}s and yields {4} (now {5} = ¥{6}).
text.夏の作物なので、いまは植えられません（いまは春）: It's a summer crop, so you can't plant it now (it's spring)
text.夏の花なので、いまは植えられません（いまは春）: It's a summer flower, so you can't plant it now (it's spring)
text.大雨で畑に水がたまりはじめています。: Heavy rain is starting to flood the fields.
text.天然水工場っス〜…採水地の水をボトルに詰めるっス〜…: This is the Water Plant~… We bottle water from the water source~…
text.天然水工場（🪵資材の⛰山開拓が解放されると採水地が見つかります）: Water Plant (a water source is found once 🪵Materials' ⛰Mountain clearing unlocks)
text.子どものころにクレヨンで描いた、「ひなたランド」の地図です！: It's a map of “Hinata Land” that I drew in crayon as a kid!
text.季節が変わったので、労働者の作業を一旦止めています。: The season changed, so workers' tasks are paused for now.
text.季節が変わったので、労働者の作業を一旦止めました。蒔く種を決めると再開します。: The season changed, so workers' tasks are paused. They'll resume once you choose seeds to sow.
text.季節ごとに植えられる花が変わります（夏：🌻ひまわり・🌺ハイビスカス・🪷蓮）。🌹バ: The flowers you can plant change with the season (Summer: 🌻sunflower · 🌺hibiscus · 🪷lotus). 🌹Roses grow all year.
text.季節ごとに植えられる花が変わります（春：🌷チューリップ・🌸桜草・🌼菜の花）。🌹バ: The flowers you can plant change with the season (Spring: 🌷tulip · 🌸primrose · 🌼rapeseed). 🌹Roses grow all year.
text.季節の終わりまであと{1}分: about {1} min until the season ends
text.季節ノルマ：夏祭り用とうもろこし: Season quota: Corn for the summer festival
text.季節ノルマ：夏祭り用とうもろこし（達成済み）: Season quota: Corn for the summer festival (done)
text.完成したら、わたしにもください！: When it's done, I want one too!
text.実った果実は、そのまま売っても、ジュース工場などの材料にしてもよろしくてよ。: You may sell the ripe fruit as is, or use it as ingredients for the Juice Factory and such.
text.害虫が出たときにも役に立つっス〜…あつかいは…慎重にっス〜…: Comes in handy when pests show up~… Handle it… carefully~…
text.家の名を取り戻すのは、ひとりじゃなくてもいい。……そう思えるようになりましたの。: Restoring my family's name doesn't have to be done alone. …I've come to think so.
text.山の木を切り出して木材にします。: Cut trees on the mountain and turn them into lumber.
text.山を借りて資材（木材）を扱う仕事を始めます。\n\n・🪓伐採：約{1}秒で木材{:
Rent a mountain and start working with materials (lumber).

· 🪓Felling: {2} lumber in about {1}s (Lv.{3}+)
· 🌲Tree planting: ¥{4} / {6} lumber in about {5}s (Lv.{7}+)
· 🏞Land clearing: ¥{8} / {10} lumber in about {9}s (Lv.{11}+)
· ⛰Mountain clearing: ¥{12} / {14} lumber in about {13}s (Lv.{15}+)

· Lumber sells all year, whatever the season ({16} for ¥{17})
· At Lv.{18} you move on to 🏗construction and earn big by putting up buildings
· ⚙️Mechanization and bulk actions are available too

Cost to start: ¥{19}
text.山を切り拓き、まとまった量の木材を得ます。: Clear the mountain and get a large amount of lumber.
text.岩山から石を切り出して石材にします。: Quarry rock from the mountain and turn it into stone.
text.工場で作るもの（工場ごと・全員共通）: What the factories make (per factory · everyone)
text.工場のページは、ショップの「🏗 増設」から増やせるっス〜…: You can add factory pages from “🏗 Expand” in the Store~…
text.工場は「🏭 工場」タブで動かせます。増設すると作れる製品のレパートリーが増えます: Run factories from the “🏭 Factories” tab. Expanding adds more products you can make.
text.工場はまだありません。下のボタンから建てられます。🧃ジュース工場の材料は🍒果樹園: No factory yet. Build one with the button below. The 🧃Juice Factory uses fruit from the 🍒Orchard.
text.工場を建てると、各工場{1}ブロック（商業施設の店舗数に合わせて最大{2}ページ:
A factory lets you make products in bulk, {1} blocks per factory (up to {2} pages, matching your number of stores).

· At first there's only the 🥤Juice Factory, which turns fruit into 🧃juice, 🥤mixed juice and 🍋honey lemonade
· Expanding unlocks the 🧀Dairy Factory, 🧵Textile Mill, 🥓Meat Plant and ⚗️Chemical Plant
· Calling “Dispatch” staff shortens production time

Cost: ¥{3}
text.工場を建てると、各工場の持ち場が使えます。: Build a factory to unlock each factory's workplace.
text.工場を建てると、🧃ジュース工場から始められます。: Build a factory to start with the 🧃Juice Factory.
text.工場を建てると使えます: Available after you build a factory
text.工房を建てると、収穫した果実を加工して高く売れるようになります。\n\n・🧃ジュ:
A workshop lets you process harvested fruit and sell it for more.

· 🧃Juice: {1} fruit → {2} bottle(s) (about {3}s · worth ×{4} the fruit)
· 🍶Liquor: {5} fruit → {6} bottle(s) (about {7}s · worth ×{8} the fruit)

Up to {9} batches at once.
Cost: ¥{10}
text.工房を建設しました！果実を酒やジュースに加工できます。（¥{1}）: Workshop built! You can turn fruit into liquor and juice. (¥{1})
text.工芸品工房ですわ。ガラス・粘土焼成品・植物繊維材から、工芸品を作りますの。: This is the Craft Workshop. We make crafts from glass, fired clay and plant fiber.
text.工芸品工房（🪵資材のガラス・粘土焼成品・植物繊維材のどれかを開くと増築できます）: Craft Workshop (expand after opening Glass, Fired clay or Plant fiber in 🪵Materials)
text.左の列の一番上の「🏠 ホーム」では、牧場の様子と、いま使える持ち場のカードが見ら: “🏠 Home” at the top of the left column shows how the farm is doing, plus cards for the workplaces you can use. Tap a card to go straight there.
text.左の雨つぶが、ほかのつぶとくっついて一気に落ちた。: The left raindrop merges with another and drops all at once.
text.帽子、貸してあげたら？: Why not lend her your hat?
text.店員が{1}回に最大{2}人までお客さまをおもてなしし、お代が入ります。席はレベ: Each clerk serves up to {2} guests per {1} round and earns their bills. Seats increase with your level (now {3} · max {4}).
text.店員を増やすほど、たくさんのお客さまをおもてなしできますわ。席はレベルが上がると: The more clerks we have, the more guests we can serve. Seats increase as you level up.
text.建築現場（Lv.{1}で🏗建築が解放されると増築できます）: Construction site (expand once 🏗Construction unlocks at Lv.{1})
text.引き継ぎコードの中身が壊れているようです。コード全体がもれなく貼り付けられている: The transfer code seems to be broken. Check that the whole code was pasted.
text.当然の結果ですわ。¥{1}ですのよ: A natural result, of course. ¥{1}, you know.
text.急がなくていいんだなーって、見てると思うっス。: Watching them makes me think there's no need to hurry.
text.成果物の小売販売先（畑・田んぼ・果樹園・養鶏・酪農・工場・資材すべて共通）: Retail outlet for products (shared by fields, rice paddies, orchards, poultry, dairy, factories and materials)
text.成績 {1}戦 {2}勝・{3}〜{4}着{5}回。寿命はあと{6}シーズン。優: Record: {1} races, {2} wins · top {3}–{4} {5} times. {6} seasons of life left. More wins, placings and experience, and more life left, mean a higher price.
text.手で触って分かること、あるよね: Some things you can only tell by touch
text.手伝ってもらうブロックをタップしてください: Tap the blocks to get help with
text.手動でセーブもできますが、{1}分に一度オートセーブもしていますので、安心して遊: You can save by hand, but the game also autosaves every {1} minute, so you can play worry-free.
text.投資先（独立した人の事業）がありません: No investments (businesses of people who went independent)
text.抹茶プリン、食べてみたい！: I want to try the matcha pudding!
text.担当の人が、作業中のブロック・育ち中の家畜・運搬中の荷物に、選んだ派遣を自動で呼: Staff automatically call the chosen dispatch workers for blocks in progress, growing animals and loads in transit (wages each time).
text.担当の持ち場で自分で作業: Work by hand at their workplace
text.担当の持ち場を開くと、お願いが届くことがあります: Visit their workplace and they may ask you for something
text.持ち場が開いたり、条件がそろったりすると、ここに増設できるものが並びます。: Things you can expand appear here as workplaces open and conditions are met.
text.排水ポンプで大雨を防ぎました！（¥{1}）: Prevented the heavy rain damage with a drainage pump! (¥{1})
text.採水地の森。しずくが、くまのぬいぐるみを抱いて立っている。: The forest by the water source. Shizuku stands holding her teddy bear.
text.採水地の水をボトルに詰めます。温泉源泉が湧くと温泉水も作れます。: Bottles water from the water source. Once a hot spring appears, it can make hot spring water too.
text.摘んだ茶葉は、お茶工場で緑茶や紅茶になりますのよ。: The picked leaves become green tea and black tea at the Tea Factory.
text.散水セットで日照りを防ぎました！（¥{1}）: Prevented the drought with a sprinkler set! (¥{1})
text.数字ではなく、手ざわりですの。母はいつも、糸の声を聞きなさいと。: It's not about numbers, it's about feel. Mother always told me to listen to the thread.
text.新しい子に、つけてあげよう: Let's give it to a new calf
text.新しく蒔く種を決めると作業を再開します。: Work resumes once you choose new seeds to sow.
text.春に植えられます。{1}袋で{2}区画。約{3}秒で育ち、{4}個とれます（いま: Plant in spring. {1} bag = {2} plot. Grows in about {3}s and yields {4} (now {5} = ¥{6}).
text.春の作物なので、いまは植えられません（いまは夏）: It's a spring crop, so you can't plant it now (it's summer)
text.春の花なので、いまは植えられません（いまは夏）: It's a spring flower, so you can't plant it now (it's summer)
text.最初に使えるのは「🌾 耕種」と「🏢 事務所」です。右上の「⚙️」が設定です。ゲー: At first you can use “🌾 Crops” and “🏢 Office.” The “⚙️” at the top right is Settings. Once the game starts, try tapping “Crops” first.

text.木村涼子さんが畑{1}P目の{2}区画をまとめて収穫しました：🌾小麦×{3}（¥: Ryoko Kimura harvested {2} plots on Field page {1}: 🌾Wheat ×{3} (¥{4})
text.本店の売り場がすべてそろいました！翌日には🐻北海道への出店が解禁されます。: The main store has every section! Tomorrow you can open a store in 🐻Hokkaido.
text.本店の青果売り場から発注：直売品{1}点を{2}秒以内に届けてください。: Order from the main store's produce section: deliver {1} direct-sale item(s) within {2}s.

text.本当に最初からやり直しますか？: Are you sure you want to start over?
text.材料がそろっていないと作れませんわ。資材の持ち場もきちんと回してくださいまし。: We can't make anything without the materials. Do keep the materials workplaces running properly.
text.材料が足りないか、ブロックが埋まって納品待ちになっています: Either ingredients are short, or blocks are full and waiting for delivery
text.材料の羊毛は酪農の羊から。足りなければ、ひなたさんにお願いなさいな。: The wool comes from the dairy's sheep. If you're short, do ask Hinata.
text.材料は酪農の豚から届くよ！ がんばろうね！: The ingredients come from the dairy's pigs! Let's do our best!
text.果実は傷ひとつで値が落ちますの。丁寧に扱ってくださいまし。: A single bruise lowers the price of fruit. Do handle it with care.
text.果樹の増設は🍒果樹園のページへ: Add fruit trees on the 🍒Orchard page
text.果樹園{1}P目の機械をアップグレードしました！一括自動収穫が使えます。（¥{2: Upgraded the machines on Orchard page {1}! Auto harvest (all) is now available. (¥{2})
text.果樹園{1}P目を機械化しました！{2}ブロックの作業時間が{3}%短くなります: Orchard page {1} mechanized! Work on {2} blocks is {3}% faster. (¥{4} / {5}-year life)
text.果樹園ですわ。さくらんぼ・桃・ぶどう・りんごを育てますの。: This is the orchard. We grow cherries, peaches, grapes and apples here.
text.案内係が{1}回に最大{2}人（動物{3}匹につき{4}人まで）を案内し、入場料: Each guide welcomes up to {2} visitors per round (up to {4} per {3} animal), earning admission fees.
text.桜……！祖母と見た、畑の桜を思い出します。ありがとうございます: Cherry blossoms…! They remind me of the field's cherry tree I saw with my grandmother. Thank you.
text.桜の苗を、ひとつだけ植えたいんです。畑の入り口の、あの場所に。: I'd like to plant one cherry sapling. Right there, at the entrance to the field.

text.気づいたら、機械の音がうるさいだけになってたっス。: Before I knew it, the machines were just noise.
text.決まりっスね〜。設定、ちょちょいとやっとくっス〜: Settled~. I'll tweak the settings real quick~

text.温泉旅館ですわ。湧いた温泉で、お客さまにお泊まりいただきますの。: This is the hot spring inn. Guests stay with us and enjoy the springs.
text.温泉水も作れるっス〜…温泉…入りたいっス〜…: We can make hot spring water too~… A hot spring… sounds nice right about now~…
text.温泉源泉の湯で、お客さまに泊まってもらいます。: Guests stay and enjoy the hot spring water.

text.照りつける日差しで畑が乾ききっています。: The blazing sun has dried out the fields.
text.牛乳や卵からチーズ・プリン・アイスを作ります。: Makes cheese, pudding and ice cream from milk and eggs.
text.牛乳・卵・肉（精肉工場の製品も並びます）: Milk, eggs, meat (Meat Plant products are sold too)
text.牛舎に飾って、みんなで大事にしよう: Let's hang it in the cowshed and treasure it together

text.牧場の野菜・卵・ミルク・お肉を使った料理を出すお店です。店員が多いほど、たくさん: A restaurant serving dishes made with the farm's vegetables, eggs, milk and meat. The more clerks, the more guests you can serve.
text.牧場の食材で作った料理を出すお店です。: A restaurant serving dishes made from farm ingredients.
text.牧場を離れて、どこかへ行こうと思っていました。: I was going to leave the farm and go somewhere else.

text.珪砂を集めて溶かし、板ガラスに仕上げます。: Collect silica sand and melt it into sheet glass.

text.着物……！こ、これは……。……一生、大切にいたしますわ: A kimono…! Th-this is… …I shall treasure it all my life.

text.祖母がはじめてここに来たときも、桜を一本植えたそうです。: They say my grandmother planted a cherry tree too, when she first came here.
text.祖母がよく言っていました。「畑は、朝いちばんに会いに来た人を覚えている」って。: My grandmother used to say, “The field remembers whoever visits it first thing in the morning.”
text.祖母が亡くなってから、牧場は一度、閉めるつもりだったんです。: After my grandmother passed away, I was going to close the farm.
text.祖母が倒れた年、わたしひとりで畑を任されたんです。: The year my grandmother fell ill, I was left to run the field on my own.
text.祖母の作付けの記録です。何十年分も、天気と種と、その日のひと言が書いてあるんです: It's my grandmother's planting record. Decades of weather, seeds, and a line or two about each day.
text.秋に植えられます。{1}袋で{2}区画。約{3}秒で育ち、{4}個とれます（いま: Plant in autumn. {1} bag = {2} plot. Grows in about {3}s and yields {4} (now {5} = ¥{6}).

text.秋の作物なので、いまは植えられません（いまは春）: It's an autumn crop, so you can't plant it now (it's spring)
text.種と肥料の種類は、上の欄から選べます。作物ごとに値段や育つまでの時間がちがいます: Pick seeds and fertilizer from the boxes at the top. Each crop has its own price and growing time, so take a look and compare.
text.種と肥料は在庫から使います。はじめは小麦の種が{1}袋と肥料が{2}袋ありますの: Seeds and fertilizer come from your stock. You start with {1} bags of wheat seeds and {2} bags of fertilizer. When you run low, buy more at “🛒 Store” in the left menu.
text.種をまくときは緑のボタン、肥料をまくときは青のボタン。育ったら畑をタップして収穫: The green button sows seeds, and the blue button spreads fertilizer. When crops are grown, tap the field to harvest.
text.空いている畑がありません（収穫するか、畑を増やしましょう）: No empty fields (harvest, or add more fields)
text.空っぽの牛舎って、すごく静かなんですよ。……あの音のしない感じ、今でも覚えてます: An empty cowshed is so quiet. …I still remember that silence!
text.粘土を掘って形を作り、窯で焼いてレンガや瓦にします。: Dig clay, shape it, and fire it in a kiln into bricks and tiles.

text.精肉工場だよ！ 豚のお肉から、ベーコン・ハム・ソーセージを作るんだ！: This is the Meat Plant! We make bacon, ham and sausages from pork!
text.糸の声……。センサーより、むずかしそうっスね〜。: Listen to the thread… sounds harder than a sensor~.
text.糸を一本でも掛け違えると、母は最初からやり直していましたわ。: If even one thread was out of place, Mother would start over from the beginning.
text.繊維工場ですわ。羊毛から、毛糸・マフラー・コートを作りますの。: This is the Textile Mill. We make yarn, scarves and coats from wool.
text.繊維工場の毛糸や服を運びます。: Carries yarn and clothes from the Textile Mill.
text.繊維工場の毛糸・マフラー・コート: Yarn, scarves and coats from the Textile Mill
text.羊の羊毛から毛糸・マフラー・コートを作ります。: Makes yarn, scarves and coats from sheep's wool.
text.羊毛が{1}個とれます（{2}秒ごと）。酪農の羊小屋に入ります。: Gives {1} wool (every {2}s). Lives in a Dairy sheep barn.
text.群は、「🛒 ショップ」の「🏗 増設」から増やせるよ！: You can add colonies from “🏗 Expand” in the “🛒 Store”!
text.翌日（次のシーズン）になると次の地方へ出店できます: You can open in the next region from the next day (next season)
text.肉が{1}個とれます（{2}秒ごと）。出荷するといなくなります。酪農の豚小屋に入: Gives {1} meat (every {2}s). Leaves once shipped. Lives in a Dairy pig barn.

text.苗木を植えて、次に切り出せる木を増やします。: Plant saplings so there are more trees to cut next time.

text.蒔く種を決めると再開します: Resumes once you choose seeds to sow
